'''Ruwon Defending the Sacred Land''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ruwon]]
* '''Published:''' 10 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Cantina|Premiere-L-tatooinecantina.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Cantina
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Tatooine Cantina Ruwon LS 2001.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

All the Jedi defend Tatooine from the evil Dark Side.

== Strategy ==

Well first off this isn't a tourny deck.  It's designed for casual play.  Regardless the principal of it is quite simple: Play Jedi, Drain lots with thier sabers from a few sites that are well fortified.  Any Ideas on theme additions or strategy additions are quite welcome, thanks for your time.
